**[P2] Start the invocation timeout after sandbox initialization**

This timestamp and its deadline are captured before a new worker loads the handler bundle. Lambda performs cold-start module initialization before applying the configured invocation timeout, so bundle load time is incorrectly deducted here and can make a valid short-timeout handler return `Sandbox.Timedout`. Initialize the worker first, then start the timer/deadline when invoking the loaded handler; cover slow module initialization followed by a quick handler.
